text: DSH Library 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地文件资料库，通过侧边栏面板和聊天输入区集成。它支持上传和浏览文件、搜索与分类、预览常见文档、收藏与批量管理，并可将文件加入聊天；agent 交付的文件也会自动归档。资料保存在本机资料库目录，可通过 DSH_HOME 指定位置，不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

DSH Library is a local DSH Web file archive opened from the sidebar and chat composer. Upload, browse, search, preview and organize files, attach them to chat, and automatically archive agent deliveries. Storage stays local and can use DSH_HOME; no API key or external service is needed.
我想在 DSH 里集中保存并浏览本地文件。
能不能在聊天时直接从资料库添加文件附件？
I want a local archive where I can browse and preview files inside DSH.
DSH Library 的功能「本地资料库存储」：将文件保存在本地资料库并维护索引，默认使用 DSH_HOME/library 或 ~/.dsh/library；启动时加载并在需要时恢复索引。
DSH Library 的功能「聊天附件与交付归档」：输入区的资料库入口可选择文件加入当前聊天；agent 通过 present 交付的文件会从会话事件捕获并写入资料库。

section: 资料库（Library）· DeepSeek Harness 插件

text: @local/dsh-library README · 中文：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个本地文件库：上传、浏览、预览、收藏、批量导出，并且和聊天打通——agent 交付的文件可以自动入库，聊天里也能把库内文件作为附件发出。纯插件实现，不需要修改 Harness 本体。

@local/dsh-library README · 功能：- **上传**：按钮或拖拽到面板，单文件上限 200 MB；同名自动加序号
- **浏览**：网格 / 列表、按时间 / 名称 / 大小排序、搜索、分类（全部 / 文件 / 图片 / 视频 / 音频 / 收藏）
- **预览**：文本、Markdown、代码、HTML（沙箱渲染 + 源码切换）、图片（内嵌预览 + 全屏灯箱：滚轮缩放、拖动、旋转、下载、删除）、PDF、Office（docx / xlsx / pptx → PDF）
- **收藏**：收藏 / 取消收藏，收藏夹（文件夹）分组，默认「未分类」
- **批量**：勾选、Shift 区间、全选、ZIP 打包下载、移到文件夹、发送到当前聊天、删除
- **聊天集成**：输入框左侧「+」→ 从资料库选文件加入草稿附件；agent 通过 `present` 交付的文件自动入库并记录来源会话
- **存储管理**：设置页可查看位置与占用、迁移到新目录、重建索引

@local/dsh-library README · 安装：前提：本机已安装 DeepSeek Harness，并有一个可用的 profile。

1. 把本仓库克隆或下载到任意位置（路径可以包含空格）：
   ```
   git clone https://github.com/gjunyoung/dsh-library.git
   ```
2. 打开 Harness → 设置 → 插件 → 安装插件包，填入该目录的**绝对路径**（或 `npm pack` 生成的 `.tgz` 路径）。
3. 在插件列表里启用「资料库」。
4. 重启 Harness。

首次启动会在 `~/.dsh/library`（Windows：`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\library`）创建存储目录。

> 安装入口在不同版本里名称可能略有差异（「安装」「添加插件」等），本质是把该目录作为当前 profile 的一个本地依赖。

@local/dsh-library README · 使用：- 侧边栏底部的资料库图标打开面板。
- 上传区支持拖拽；列表右侧「…」菜单有预览、下载、收藏、移到文件夹、删除。
- 预览抽屉：图片和 PDF 可放大，HTML 默认渲染、可切源码，Office 首次打开会转换一次（有缓存）。
- 收藏：根层是文件夹列表（未分类 + 各收藏夹），进入文件夹后可用搜索；「…」里的「收藏」会打开文件夹选择器，已收藏的文件显示「取消收藏」。
- 批量条悬浮在面板底部：全选 / 取消全选 / 下载（ZIP）/ 移到文件夹 / 发送到聊天 / 删除。

@local/dsh-library README · 存储：```
~/.dsh/library/
├─ index.json          记录（文件名、大小、哈希、来源、收藏、所属收藏夹）
├─ index.backup.json   上一次的索引备份
├─ blobs/<2>/<sha>.bin 按内容寻址的文件本体（同内容只存一份）

- **备份**：整个目录复制走即可；恢复时放回同一位置。
- **迁移**：设置 → 资料库 → 填入新目录绝对路径 → 迁移。会搬运文件、校验后删除旧目录里的库数据，并记住新位置（重启仍生效）。
- **重建索引**：用磁盘上的字节重写 `index.json`。索引损坏、或手动动过目录时使用；索引里没有的文件会以 `recovered-<hash前8位>` 出现，原名与收藏信息无法恢复。

@local/dsh-library README · 已知限制：- **Office 走 PDF**：docx / xlsx / pptx 由 Harness 内置的转换能力转成 PDF 显示，不解析原始表格；Excel 的公式、图表不会单独渲染。
- **HTML 单文件**：预览在沙箱 iframe 中以 `srcdoc` 渲染，脚本可运行但读不到应用数据、也无法访问外网；`./style.css` 这类相对引用不可用。
- **预览是页内抽屉**：Harness 右侧栏的文档预览是会话作用域的，资料库是全局面板，因此预览放在面板内部的抽屉里。
- **自动入库只认交付**：agent 用 `present` 交付的文件会自动入库；`write` / `edit` 直接写进工作区的文件不会自动入库（避免把临时文件都塞进来）。
- **批量收藏未提供**：收藏走单条操作。

@local/dsh-library README · 开发：```
packages/library/（本仓库根目录）
├─ index.js          Host 半边：路由、会话事件捕获、打开系统程序
├─ client.js         Client 半边：面板、预览、灯箱、批量、设置页
├─ lib/              engine（存储与索引）、http、model、render、capture、zip、office

运行测试（Node 22+）：

```
node --test "test/*.test.js"
```

客户端半边只允许 `require('react')`；与 Harness 的交互一律通过 slot 注册与 loopback HTTP 完成，这也是它能作为纯插件工作的原因。

@local/dsh-library README · English：> A local file library for DeepSeek Harness: upload, preview, favourite, batch export, and attach files to chat.

A local file library for DeepSeek Harness: upload, browse, preview, favourite and batch-export files, wired into the chat — deliverables an agent presents are archived automatically, and library files can be attached to a message. It is a pure plugin: nothing in Harness itself changes.

@local/dsh-library README · Features：- **Upload** — button or drag-and-drop, 200 MB per file, duplicate names get a suffix
- **Browse** — grid / list, sort by date / name / size, search, and categories (all / documents / images / video / audio / favourites)
- **Preview** — text, Markdown, code, HTML (sandboxed render with a source toggle), images (inline preview plus a full-screen viewer with wheel zoom, pan, rotate, download, delete), PDF, Office (docx / xlsx / pptx → PDF)
- **Favourites** — star a file, group favourites into folders, `Unfiled` by default
- **Batch actions** — checkboxes, Shift range, select all, ZIP download, move to folder, send to the current chat, delete
- **Chat integration** — the `+` button in the composer picks files from the library; files an agent delivers through `present` are archived with their source session
- **Storage management** — the settings page shows the location and size, moves the archive, and rebuilds the index

@local/dsh-library README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness with a working profile.

1. Clone or download this repository anywhere (paths with spaces are fine):
   ```
   git clone https://github.com/gjunyoung/dsh-library.git
   ```
2. Open Harness → Settings → Plugins → install a bundle, and give the **absolute path** of that directory (or of an `npm pack` `.tgz`).
3. Enable “Library” in the plugin list.
4. Restart Harness.

The first start creates the archive at `~/.dsh/library` (`C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\library` on Windows).

@local/dsh-library README · Install：> The install entry point is named slightly differently across releases (“Install”, “Add plugin”, …); it always ends up as a local dependency of the current profile.

@local/dsh-library README · Usage：- Open the panel from the library icon at the bottom of the sidebar.
- Drop files anywhere on the panel; the `…` menu on a row offers preview, download, favourite, move to folder and delete.
- The preview drawer zooms images and PDFs, renders HTML by default (with a source switch), and converts Office files once on first open (cached afterwards).
- Favourites open on a folder list (`Unfiled` plus your folders); inside a folder the search box applies, and the `…` menu opens a folder picker — already-favourited files show “Remove from favourites”.
- The floating batch bar offers select all / clear, download as ZIP, move to folder, send to chat and delete.

@local/dsh-library README · Storage：```
~/.dsh/library/
├─ index.json          records (name, size, hash, source, favourite, folder)
├─ index.backup.json   previous index backup
├─ blobs/<2>/<sha>.bin content-addressed bytes (identical content stored once)

@local/dsh-library README · Known limitations：- **Office renders as PDF** — docx / xlsx / pptx go through Harness's built-in converter; the original spreadsheet layout, formulas and charts are not rendered natively.
- **HTML is single-file** — the preview renders in a sandboxed `srcdoc` iframe: scripts run, but the page cannot read application data or reach the network, and relative references such as `./style.css` do not resolve.
- **The preview is an in-panel drawer** — Harness's right-sidebar document preview is session-scoped, while the library is a global panel.
- **Only deliveries are archived automatically** — files an agent returns through `present` are captured; plain `write` / `edit` changes in the workspace are not (that would pull in every scratch file).
- **No batch favourite** — favourites are a per-file action.

@local/dsh-library README · Development：```
index.js         host half: routes, session-event capture, "open in system"
client.js        client half: panel, preview, viewer, batch bar, settings
lib/             engine (archive + index), http, model, render, capture, zip, office
locale/          zh / en dictionaries

Run the tests (Node 22+):

```
node --test "test/*.test.js"
```

@local/dsh-library README · Development：The client half may only `require('react')`; everything it needs from Harness goes through slot registration and loopback HTTP, which is what keeps this a pure plugin.
